newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh waives duty on generator imports.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh waives duty on generator imports.

text.p: Bangladesh on Tuesday waived duties and Value Added Tax (VAT) on imports of power generators to curb a growing shortfall in electricity generation, revenue officials said.
All types of generators for use in commercial establishments and industries are exempt but machinery for major power plants is not included.
"Imports of all types of generators have been made duty and tax free. This has been done for a greater interest of the country although there will be some revenue losses," said one official.
He said: "We expect the step will ease the crisis to a large extent. Industrial units could now import high capacity generators to meet their own needs."
Bangladesh's VAT rate rate is 15 percent, while the import duty on generators was 7.5 percent.
The decision coincides with a crippling power shortage in the country. The business community has complained that frequent power cuts have threatened industrial production.
